english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when you are glad to accept suggestions, ideas, or other input.
Use this when you mean warmly welcoming someone rather than simply saying hello.

examples.english: We welcome any new ideas you have.
examples.traditional: 你有咩新諗法，我哋都歡迎。
examples.jyutping: nei5 jau5 me1 san1 nam2 faat3 ngo5 dei6 dou1 fun1 jing4

examples.english: We greet the new colleague warmly at the door.
examples.traditional: 我哋喺門口歡迎新同事。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 mun4 hau2 fun1 jing4 san1 tung4 si6
